name: Gyaru Ane Z ~Gachi Kimochiii!! Atashi-tachi ga Anta no Niku Onaho ni Natte Yaru!!~
original_name: ギャル姉Ｚ〜ガチ気持ちイイ！！　アタシたちがアンタの肉オナホになってやる！！〜
source:
[i]Those bitch sisters who look down on me... just you wait.[/i]

The protagonist, Niihara Daiki, has been used as a personal errand boy by his domineering sisters ever since he was little. Whenever Daiki is home, he handles all the chores. The moment he tries to protest, they start hitting him and unilaterally cast him as the bad guy. This is his daily life.

Fed up with this routine, Daiki one day hears about a hypnosis device from an upperclassman at his university. He tries it half in disbelief, but the effect is immediate - his sisters become obedient to his every command.

[i]Hahaha, this is amazing! Those sisters of mine, doing whatever I say![/i]

And so he begins using the hypnosis device, behaving at home as if to vent all his pent-up resentment - but...

[Adapted from the [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/gaz/en/feature.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
[i]那些看不起我的贱人姐妹们……你们等着吧。[/i]

主人公新原大树从小就被霸道的姐妹们当作贴身跑腿。每当大树在家时，他就会处理所有的家务事。当他试图抗议时，他们就开始打他，并单方面把他视为坏人。这就是他的日常生活。

大树厌倦了这种例行公事，有一天从他大学的一位高年级学生那里听说了一种催眠装置。他半信半疑地尝试了一下，但效果立竿见影——他的姐妹们变得服从他的每一个命令。

[i]哈哈哈，这太棒了！我的姐妹们，我说什么就做什么！[/i]

于是他开始使用催眠装置，在家里表现得好像要发泄所有压抑的怨恨——但是……
